title: Amaranthium (Quai)
description: The second main-line Amaranthium Mod, Official Sequel mod to 'Amaranthium (Jest)'.
body:
Amaranthium (Quai) is a mod I made for my brother, following the same ridiculousness as Amaranthium (Jest) and any sequels to come.

This mod adds a few Warhammer 40K references because my brother likes 40K, these Items are:
1. Chain Sword
2. Bio Sword
3. Bolter (Model by: QuaiAmaranth)
4. Bio Cannon
5. Bile Cannon
6. Bio Sickles
7. Scything Claws

This mod also adds a few guns, and they have 3 Teirs:
Wood,
Stone,
and Iron.

The Guns in question are:
Pistols,
Revolvers,
and Snipers.

The ammunition (ammo) for the guns are
Wooden pellets (Wood)
Stone Shot (Stone)
Iron Round (Iron)
Biomatter (Bio cannon & Bile cannon)

this mod adds 1 new effect,
'Infected'
while Infected, Arthropods frequently spawn on you.

there is an Item made with Biomatter and Echo Shards called 'Cursed flesh' which applies good and bad effects to you, making a 'Ceramite Brace' and holding it in your hand clears all effects from you.
Eating the Cursed flesh spawns a new boss, the Tyranid Warrior (Specifically the Hive Fleet Leviathan Tyranid Warrior) from Warhammer 40K.
this boss has 666 health and is projectile heavy, shooting Biomatter at you about every 1.5 seconds.


Anyone who wants to make an addon for this mod can if they wish.
jEI is Helpful.
